evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Directly states the high-level goal of terminating specific types of track data.

evidence_cards.content: The objective is to terminate and purge subsurface surveillance tracks, specifically by transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message when a JU ceases reporting a track or deactivates NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, and FWDAs.

evidence_cards.content: A surveillance JU will accept the PPLI information into its surveillance database and perform the applicable correlation and conflict processing necessary to ensure that duplicative information is not being transmitted on the Surveillance Network PG.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a mandatory pre-use-case state: the surveillance JU must have already accepted PPLI data and performed correlation/conflict processing — indicating that track deduplication infrastructure must be active prior to initiating termination/purge actions.

evidence_cards.content: A JU may have the capability to purge remote tracks/points, i.e., automatically drop a remote track/point after a specified time interval has elapsed since the track's/point's last report.

evidence_cards.content: A J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a track for which it currently has R2.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state (possession of R2) and condition (ceasing to report) required before the termination message transmission can occur.

evidence_cards.content: After initially achieving Active status, or after returning to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure, C2 JUs capable of assuming R2 shall not transmit tracks until sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a mandatory pre-condition regarding system status (Active) and completed checks that must be satisfied before a JU can assume R2 and subsequently manage/terminate tracks.

evidence_cards.content: A J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a track, except when that track becomes an active IU on the network with the same address as was previously being used as the reference TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state condition (cessation of reporting by JU) required to trigger the transmission of the termination message for subsurface tracks.

evidence_cards.content: For NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, and FWDAs, a J7.0 (ACT=0) message shall be transmitted at time of deactivation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the precondition of deactivation for specific operational areas (NOTACK, Moving Havens, FWDAs) to initiate the termination process.

evidence_cards.content: Automatic purging of remote tracks occurs after a specific time interval has elapsed since the last report, provided no J7.0 (ACT = 0) message was received.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the temporal precondition (elapsed time interval without updates) necessary for the system to automatically purge remote tracks.

evidence_cards.content: For the termination of a ballistic missile track via a J7.0 message (ACT=0), the C2 JU must currently possess R² (Responsibility) for that specific track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a critical system state (possession of R²) that must hold before the specific termination action can be performed by the JU.

evidence_cards.content: The transmission of EW product information shall be terminated when the information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific condition (invalidity or missed updates) under which EW data transmission terminates, serving as a precondition for the termination process described in this section.

evidence_cards.content: Each track/point initiated and reported shall be assigned a TN from the JU's allocated block.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that a track must exist with an assigned Track Number (TN) from the JU's block before it can be terminated or purged.

evidence_cards.content: At that time, the JU shall have R² for the track/point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies that the JU must possess reporting responsibility (R²) for the track at the time of initiation, which is a prerequisite state for managing (and subsequently terminating) the track.

evidence_cards.content: The use case applies to C2 JUs that have the capability to originate and report real-time air, surface (maritime), land (ground), or space tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the required system capability state for the primary actor before track termination/purge operations can occur; only JUs with these reporting capabilities are subject to the correlation/decorrelation rules that lead to track termination.

evidence_cards.content: A track must exist as either a 'common local track' (positional data locally derived but currently reported by another C2 JU) or a 'local track' (positional data locally derived and not currently reported by another C2 JU).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the necessary track existence states that must hold before termination/purge procedures can be applied; these are the specific track types governed by the common tracking protocols.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a track for which it currently has R², except in specific cases.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the precondition that the C2 JU must possess reporting responsibility (R²) for the track to initiate the termination transmission process.

evidence_cards.content: There may be cases when a system does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and receives no further updates on the remote track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific state (missing termination message and lack of updates) that serves as the precondition for the 'Purging of Remote Tracks' sub-process.

evidence_cards.content: A ballistic missile track must exist for which the JU currently has R² (responsibility) before a J7.0 message with Track Management Action field set to value 0 (Drop Track Report) is transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the specific precondition of possessing R² on an existing track required to initiate the termination process via the Drop Track Report message.

evidence_cards.content: For purging remote tracks, the system must be in a state where it does not receive a J7.0 message (ACT = 0) and receives no further updates on the remote ballistic missile track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific absence-of-update condition that serves as the entry state for the automatic purge use case.

evidence_cards.content: The recognition and resolution of dual designations require all IUs to periodically compare remote tracks to local tracks (and, optionally, to common local tracks) to determine if a dual designation has occurred.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the general precondition that tracks must exist (remote/local) and be subject to periodic comparison for the system to recognize conditions (dual designation) that lead to correlation actions.

evidence_cards.content: All C2 JUs capable of reporting air or surface tracks shall have the capability to transmit and receive all the response values of the J7.2 message for real-time air and/or surface tracks, which are held locally by their system.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific precondition regarding track category (Air/Surface) and system state (holding tracks locally) required for the C2 JU to participate in the correlation process described.

evidence_cards.content: A J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a track for which it currently has R², except when the JU ceases reporting because it has relinquished R² to another JU or when the track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary precondition for transmitting the termination message for locally held tracks.

evidence_cards.content: For purging remote tracks, the precondition is that the system does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and receives no further updates on the remote track.

evidence_cards.content: The trigger for the C2 JU to assume R² of an IU (and report it as a track or point) is when: (a) A J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds; (b) A J2 PPLI message, other than J2.0, is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence; (c) A J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU; or (d) The Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: These are explicit events that initiate the C2 JU’s assumption of responsibility and reporting behavior — directly corresponding to triggers for terminating/purging tracks via transition to inactive/limited status reporting.

evidence_cards.content: The trigger for automatic purging of a remote track/point is the elapse of a specified time interval since the track's/point's last report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the event that starts the automatic purge action for remote tracks, which is part of the 'Terminate and Purge Surveillance Tracks' use case.

evidence_cards.content: For subsurface surveillance tracks, termination via J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is triggered when the JU ceases reporting the track or deactivates relevant NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, or FWDAs.

evidence_cards.content: The trigger for transmitting a J7.0 (ACT=0) message in NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, and FWDAs is the time of deactivation.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the condition (time interval elapse without updates) that initiates the purge process for remote tracks.

evidence_cards.content: After decorrelation of PPLI and local track data, the C² JU shall initiate a surveillance track report with locally held data using a new track number.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a core action in the main flow: initiating a new track report after decorrelation, which is part of terminating the old correlated track and starting fresh — aligning with the use case goal of purging/terminating tracks.

evidence_cards.content: The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator field and the PPLI IFF/SIF Indicator field shall both be reported as No Statement after decorrelation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies mandatory reporting behavior during the main flow step following decorrelation — constraining how the system must represent identity and tracking fields when restarting surveillance reporting.

evidence_cards.content: A JU may have the capability to purge remote tracks/points by automatically dropping a remote track/point after a specified time interval has elapsed since the track's/point's last report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the automatic purging action in the main flow for remote tracks based on time intervals.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a constraint on system behavior during the purging process in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a point when the point becomes an Active IU on the interface with the same TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific constraint in the main flow regarding the transmission of termination messages for points that are transitioning to active status.

evidence_cards.content: JUs may purge remote reference points, lines, and areas and land (ground) points if they are no longer required; when purged by local options, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the action sequence for purging remote tracks via local options, explicitly stating that no termination message is sent in this path.

evidence_cards.content: Emergency points are normally terminated via the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message when the emergency ceases.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the standard termination mechanism for emergency points within the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU ceases reporting a track for which it currently has R² (except when relinquishing R² or the track becomes an Active IU), the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the primary step in the main flow for terminating local tracks via message transmission.

evidence_cards.content: If a system does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and receives no further updates on a remote track, it must have the capability to automatically purge those tracks after a specific time interval.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the condition/parameter required to execute the automatic purge step.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message when it ceases reporting a subsurface track, except when that track becomes an active IU on the network with the same address as was previously being used as the reference TN.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU drops or ceases reporting EW information that it has been reporting on the interface, it shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted on remote reports.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Constrains the main flow by specifying that termination messages are not used for remote tracks.

evidence_cards.content: Remote reports may be automatically purged based on system criteria.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the alternative path for remote tracks within the use case scope (automatic purge vs manual termination).

evidence_cards.content: NonC² JUs shall process J7.0 messages with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, for locally held remote tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the processing step for receiving entities when a termination message is sent.

evidence_cards.content: A change from live to simulated track status shall be accepted if the track is being received from an FJU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a specific exception to the rule that simulation indicator shall not change, representing a successful alternative path where the system accepts a status change without dropping and re-reporting the track.

evidence_cards.content: For automatic purging of remote tracks/points, the JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a purged remote track/point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an alternative flow for purge where no termination message is sent, diverging from the main flow step of transmitting J7.0 (ACT=0), yet still successfully completing the purge action.

evidence_cards.content: A J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is NOT transmitted when a JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished R² to another JU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow where the main action of transmitting a termination message is skipped due to a specific condition (relinquishment).

evidence_cards.content: A J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is NOT transmitted when the track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow where the main action of transmitting a termination message is skipped due to the track becoming an Active IU.

evidence_cards.content: An alternative flow for terminating a subsurface track occurs when the track becomes an active IU on the network with the same address as was previously being used as the reference TN; in this case, the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is not transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific condition under which the standard termination message transmission is skipped, representing a valid alternative path to successful termination.

evidence_cards.content: An alternative flow for purging remote tracks occurs when a system does not receive a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and receives no further updates; the system automatically purges those tracks (DRT = 0-3) after a specific time interval without transmitting a termination message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the automatic purge mechanism triggered by timeout rather than explicit termination message, diverging from the main flow of message-based termination.

evidence_cards.content: Differences in ballistic missile position or velocity recognized by a JU are not resolved through conflict processing and shall not generate a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 1, Difference Report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative path where data differences do not trigger the standard difference reporting mechanism (J7.0 ACT=1) used in other contexts, but instead result in no action regarding the report generation for that specific element type.

evidence_cards.content: A unit assuming R² for a ballistic missile track need not assume R² for the associated launch point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a variant in responsibility assumption (R²) where the unit handling the missile track is not required to take responsibility for the launch point, diverging from potential assumptions of full track association.

evidence_cards.content: NonC² JUs may have the capability to automatically purge locally held remote tracks after a specified time interval when these tracks are no longer being updated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative success path (automatic purge) for terminating tracks without transmitting a termination message, diverging from the main flow's explicit J7.0 transmission step.

evidence_cards.content: A J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be sent when a track is no longer being reported due to a shift in R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow where the standard termination message transmission is suppressed because the condition for sending it (having R²) is lost via a shift rather than cessation of reporting.

evidence_cards.content: If for any reason, such as operator error, it is desired to change the simulation status of a track, the track shall be dropped using the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message, and a new track shall be reported.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception handling path where an operator error triggers a specific termination and restart sequence (drop and report new) rather than a standard status update.

evidence_cards.content: The one exception to this rule is that a change from live to simulated shall be accepted if the track is being received from an FJU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific conditional exception where the standard 'drop and re-report' procedure for status changes is overridden by the source of the track (FJU).

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a point, line, or area is not required to purge the point, line, or area; however, if it does not purge, it shall assume R² for that entity to ensure it remains active on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception flow where the expected outcome of a termination message (purge) does not occur, and specifies the system's compensatory action (assuming R²).

evidence_cards.content: When a remote reference point, line, area, or land (ground) point is purged from a system by local options because it is no longer required, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception condition where the standard termination message transmission is suppressed during a purge operation triggered by local configuration rather than track status changes.

evidence_cards.content: Differences in position, velocity, or depth recognized by a JU are not resolved through automated conflict processing and shall not generate a J7.0 (ACT = 1 or 2) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception flow where detected information differences (position, velocity, depth) result in no termination message being generated, diverging from the standard resolution procedure.

evidence_cards.content: DATUMS (DRT = 4) shall not be purged automatically.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception to the automatic purge alternative flow; unlike other remote tracks, DATUMS are explicitly excluded from automatic purging even if updates cease.

evidence_cards.content: A JU receiving a J7.0 message with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, on a locally held track shall assume R² at the next opportunity to transmit the track if local reporting eligibility remains and a remote report has not been received on that track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception condition where receipt of a termination message (J7.0 ACT=0) does not result in immediate track drop but instead triggers assumption of responsibility (R²), diverging from standard termination behavior.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² for a nonreal-time track, i.e., TQ field set to value 0, shall assume R² for that track when the track is locally updated by a new nonreal-time report. A JU reporting a nonreal-time track has R² regardless of the time value in the track report. The time value in a nonreal-time report is not a criterion for an R² shift.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception flow for nonreal-time tracks where R² assumption occurs upon local update despite lack of prior R², overriding normal time-based or remote-report criteria — this affects how termination/purge logic may be bypassed or altered under specific conditions.

evidence_cards.content: A JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ greater than local TQ.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies an exception condition under which R² is relinquished due to external data quality (TQ comparison), potentially interrupting or altering the expected termination/purge sequence if triggered during active tracking.

evidence_cards.content: After applying all the above rules, a JU relinquishes R² for a real-time track upon reception of a remote track report with TQ equal to the local TQ from a JU whose Source TN is greater than the local Source TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Adds another exception path for R² relinquishment based on source identifier precedence when TQ values are equal — this can override local retention assumptions and affect whether/when a track is eligible for purge or termination.

evidence_cards.content: A unit assuming R² for a ballistic missile track need not assume R² for the associated launch point. The unit no longer holding R² on the ballistic missile track may continue to report the launch point in accordance with the transmit/receive rules.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes an exception for ballistic missile tracks where responsibility (R²) for the track does not extend to its launch point, allowing continued reporting of the launch point even after R² is lost on the main track — this creates a partial termination scenario that deviates from full purge expectations.

evidence_cards.content: NonC² JUs shall process J7.0 messages with the Track Management Action field set to value 0, Drop Track Report, for locally held remote tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a mandatory exception handling path (processing a termination message) specifically for NonC² JUs, distinct from the C2 JU main flow which transmits such messages.

evidence_cards.content: NonC² JUs may have the capability to automatically purge locally held remote tracks after a specified time interval when these tracks are no longer being updated, where the time interval is a system selected parameter.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an optional alternative/exception flow for NonC² JUs regarding automatic purging of remote tracks based on timeout, providing specific constraints on the trigger condition and parameter nature.

evidence_cards.content: The correlation shall be deemed to have failed if no J7.0 (ACT = 0) is received for the dropped TN after a period of 60 seconds from the transmission of the correlation request and all associated processing for the correlation shall be cancelled.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an explicit failure condition (timeout) and system response (cancel processing) for the correlation process, which constitutes an exception flow for track termination/purge operations involving correlation.

evidence_cards.content: If the Dropped TN is reported by another IU after transmission of the J7.0, own unit shall retain the Dropped TN as a remote track and shall not reattempt to correlate the Retained TN and the Dropped TN for a period of 60 seconds after transmission of the J7.0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a recovery/continuation behavior following a potential conflict scenario where the dropped track is unexpectedly reported again, preventing immediate re-correlation attempts for 60 seconds.

evidence_cards.content: When a C2 JU ceases reporting a track because it has relinquished R² to another JU, the J7.0 (ACT = 0) termination message shall not be transmitted.

evidence_cards.content: After successful termination and purge of a subsurface track via J7.0 (ACT = 0) message transmission, the C2 JU ceases reporting that track on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the observable system state after successful termination: cessation of track reporting by the JU.

evidence_cards.content: After automatic purging of a remote track/point (DRT = 0-3), the system no longer retains or displays that track following expiration of the specified time interval since last update.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the post-purge state for remotely tracked entities — they are removed from system view/storage after timeout.

evidence_cards.content: DATUMS (DRT = 4) are not automatically purged; thus, their presence in the system persists even after elapsed time intervals unless manually terminated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Clarifies an exception to the general purge outcome — DATUM tracks remain in system state post-timeout, affecting overall postcondition scope.

evidence_cards.content: The surveillance track is terminated and purged from the system.

source_locations.location: Section 4.4.6.17 (Termination of Ballistic Missile Track Data) and Section 4.4.6.17.2 (Purging of Remote Ballistic Missile Tracks)

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Directly defines the resulting system state after successful termination or automatic purge: the track no longer exists in the system's active track database.

evidence_cards.content: For automatic purge of remote tracks (when no J7.0 message is received), the postcondition is that the locally held remote track is purged after a specified system-selected time interval has elapsed since it was last updated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the successful end state for the automatic purge alternative flow: the removal of the track from the local system.

evidence_cards.content: The processing of a J7.0 message with Track Management Action set to value 0 (Drop Track Report) results in the termination/purge action for locally held remote tracks.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the immediate result of the termination message trigger, leading to the purging of the track.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message indicates that the JU with R² specified in the Source TN field has dropped or has ceased reporting the track specified in the Reference TN field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the observable system state after successful transmission of a termination message: the originating JU is confirmed to have dropped or ceased reporting the specified track.

evidence_cards.content: A J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be sent when a track is no longer being reported due to a shift in R².

source_locations.location: Section 4.7.1.1 DROP TRACK REPORT, paragraph 1, last sentence

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Clarifies an exception condition where the postcondition of 'track dropped' does not result from a J7.0 (ACT=0) message — relevant for defining boundary conditions of successful termination via this mechanism.

evidence_cards.content: For automatic purging of a remote track/point, the specified time interval since its last report has elapsed, no J7.0 (ACT = 0) message has been received for it, and no further updates have been received on it.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the state conditions required before the system can automatically purge a remote track: timer expiry, absence of termination message, and absence of updates.

evidence_cards.content: The minimum wait before reporting air and surface tracks is 12 seconds and for land tracks is 48 seconds after initially achieving Active status or returning to Active status from Inactive status or TDS Failure.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a temporal precondition that must hold before a C2 JU can transmit tracks after regaining active status, which may precede termination actions if the track was inactive.

evidence_cards.content: NOTACK Area, Moving Haven, and FWDA will be reported with both time of activation and/or time of deactivation; if both times are not received, the default period for NOTACK Areas is 2 hours and for FWDAs is 155 minutes.

source_locations.location: paragraph following list item f. Friendly Weapon Danger Area (FWDA)

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that these ASW point types have defined temporal states (activation/deactivation) and default durations, implying they must exist in an active state prior to deactivation — a prerequisite condition for triggering subsurface track termination via J7.0 (ACT = 0).

evidence_cards.content: For Sonobuoy Position and Sonobuoy Pattern Reference Position, time of deactivation will be reported to specify the time of expiration of deployed assets, or time of activation will be reported to specify the time for the deployment of future assets.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Confirms that sonobuoy-related positions also carry explicit activation/deactivation timing, reinforcing that such entities must be in an active or scheduled state before being deactivated — supporting the precondition that associated ASW areas/points must be active before deactivation triggers track termination.
